hint.shake.touch: The flashlight died. Rub the flashlight button quickly
hint.shake.motion: The flashlight died. Shake the phone or rub the flashlight button
brief.return: Then return to the hatch and climb out
find.journal.name: Duty log
find.journal.desc: The last entry is unsigned. The shift was never handed over.
find.order.name: Order No. 14
find.order.desc: Forbidding descent to the lower level without an escort.
find.scheme.name: Shelter plan
find.scheme.desc: The third level is hatched over by hand.
find.photo.name: Photograph
find.photo.desc: Six people by the blast door. Only a year on the back.
find.gasmask.name: Gas mask in its bag
find.gasmask.desc: The bag is buckled shut; the lenses are fogged from inside.
find.medkit.name: First-aid kit
find.medkit.desc: All the tubes are in place. One has been opened.
find.ration.name: Field ration
find.ration.desc: The tins have swollen. Better not open them.
find.dosimeter.name: Dosimeter
find.dosimeter.desc: The needle rests at zero and twitches near doorways.
find.receiver.name: Radio receiver
find.receiver.desc: One frequency is marked on the dial in pencil.
find.lamp.name: Miner's lamp
find.lamp.desc: The glass is sooted from the inside.
find.tape.name: Reel of tape
find.badge.name: Duty officer's tag
find.badge.desc: The number has been filed off.
find.keys.name: Bunch of keys
find.keys.desc: Seven keys. The plan shows six doors.
find.stamp.name: Rubber stamp
find.stamp.desc: “For packets.” The ink has dried out.
find.tube.name: Radio valve
find.tube.desc: The bulb is intact; the filament has burned through.
find.pennant.name: Pennant
find.pennant.desc: “To the best shift.” The year was stitched later, in different thread.
act.exit.touch: Hold the button to climb out
toast.alldone: Assignment complete. Return to the hatch
hint.empty: The battery is dead. No spares left

teach.shoot.touch: Keep the target in the beam and hold the button on the right
teach.take.desktop: E — take what is in front of you
teach.take.touch: Button on the right — take what is in front of you
teach.swap: R — change the battery ahead of time
teach.water: Water slows you down, and the flashlight dies more often
teach.swarm: Keep the beam on it and it falls apart. Not for long
ui.lang.name: English
title.how: Walk. Look. Shine the light. Nothing else is asked of you.
title.warn: Contains flashing lights and sudden changes of place.
limbo.wait: rendering the next one from what is left…
limbo.line.0: low detail is not an error. this is how you kept it.
limbo.line.1: people who remembered this also remembered: the smell of the stairwell.
limbo.line.2: your childhood was archived due to inactivity.
limbo.line.3: this memory is not sponsored. yet.
limbo.line.4: nothing here is saved. everything here is kept.
limbo.line.5: skip intro? you can't. you are the intro.
teach.dark: Light off: what you are looking for shows through the walls.
teach.thing: Things do not like being stared at.
mem.kettle.flash: the kettle. you left it on.
mem.kettle.done: it was cold. it was always cold.
mem.iron.flash: the iron. did you unplug it?
mem.iron.done: unplugged. you checked three times. you will check again.
mem.phone.flash: your phone is ringing somewhere. unknown number.
mem.phone.done: one new memory. tap to dismiss.
mem.keys.flash: the keys. you had them a second ago.
mem.keys.done: they open a door that is not here any more.
mem.teddy.flash: you promised to come back for him.
mem.teddy.done: he waited. he is not angry. that is worse.
mem.slippers.flash: someone's slippers by the door. whose?
mem.alarm.flash: the alarm is set for an hour that does not exist.
mem.alarm.done: it rang yesterday. you slept through the whole year.
mem.mug.flash: the tea you made and forgot.
mem.mug.done: a ring on the table. nothing else is left.
mem.photo.flash: a photo of everyone. the faces did not save.
mem.photo.done: you are in it. third from the left. probably.
mem.call.flash: a phone with a dial. it knows one number by heart.
mem.call.done: you dialled home. home picked up and breathed.
mem.nightlight.flash: the night light. do not turn it off.
mem.nightlight.done: it was never for the dark. it was for you.
mem.bag.flash: the homework is due. it has been due for twenty years.
mem.bag.done: inside: one page. your handwriting. not your words.
mem.cake.done: the candles count something. not years.
mem.ball.flash: the ball went over the fence. go and get it.
mem.ball.done: nobody was waiting for it. you brought it back anyway.
mem.fish.flash: you forgot to feed the fish.
mem.fish.done: it forgot you first. three seconds at a time.
mem.remote.flash: where is the remote? the channel will not change.
pocket.void.enter: this is what you kept. the blank ones are still missing.
pocket.meadow.enter: default background. nothing finds you here. the door opens nearer to it.
pocket.dollhouse.enter: the same rooms, smaller. the light on the table is where you left it.
pocket.dollhouse.enter.idle: the same rooms, smaller. nothing is missing yet.
pocket.dollhouse.map.idle: you were here. nothing is missing yet.
pocket.hint.fading: This place is fading. It will let you go
